user.title: Add LEDUP lights
user.description: Commands are broadcast: every light of this product in range of the relay reacts.

data_description.product: Text after pid= in the light's QR code, lowercased. Unknown? Choose the first option to find it by toggling the lights.
data_description.relay: A Bluetooth proxy running esphome/ledup.yaml, near the lights.

probe.title: Finding your product ({number}/{total})
probe.description:
Sent Switch for **{product}**. Did your lights just toggle (on to off, or off to on)?

If more than one product toggles them, the first one you confirm is used.

abort.no_relays: No ESPHome relay found. Add esphome/ledup.yaml from the LEDUP README to a Bluetooth proxy, install it, then try again.
abort.not_found: No product toggled the lights. Check the relay is near the lights and powered, then try again.
